outcome: Duration of first stage of labor
cohort: 108 pregnant women with idiopathic polyhydramnios and 216 matched controls
finding: Idiopathic polyhydramnios significantly increased the risk of cesarean section, even after adjusting for confounding variables.
mod_finding: Idiopathic polyhydramnios was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section, even after adjusting for induced labor and non-vertex presentation.
